card.name: Word endings before adverbs or objects
card.fires_on: Word endings such as -ed in thwarted or -ly in overtly and Hardly, and the token after Administer or Increase. It also fires inside tadalafil after Increase t.

modes.label: Adverb or verb endings
modes.description: A short ending like -ed or -ly closes a verb or adverb in running prose.
modes.example: the Jim Crow system thwart<<ed>> their efforts to receive a quality education

modes.label: Dose-instruction verbs
modes.description: The word after Administer, or the tail of tadalafil after Increase, in dosing directions.
modes.example: Administer<< injections>> slowly, with frequent aspirations before and during
